newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan bourse slips after dividend payments.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan bourse slips after dividend payments.

text.p: Share indices on the Abidjan bourse fell in the week to Friday following dividend payments by brewers SOLIBRA, ELF OIL-CI and ironmongers BERNABE-CI, its market report said.
The All-Share Index fell 1.09 percent to 393.69 points, trimming the 1997 rise 10.03 percent.
The 12 VB blue-chip index shed 1.13 percent to 268.73, pushing the 1997 rise lower to 11.05 percent.

SOLIBRA fell 10,460 CFA francs to 65,690 CFA, ELF fell 3,580 to 30,290 and BERNABE, which was down 1,840 at 18,110, led the losers. They paid dividends of 12,000 CFA, 3,977 CFA and 2,100 CFA, respectively.
Cement company SOCIMAT-CI, which rose 380 to 36,500, led a field of modest risers.
A total of 4,103 shares worth 69,462,270 CFA francs changed hands.
